general_information.Syllabus Name: Building Cross-Platform Back-End Application With .NET_Xây dựng ứng dụng back-end với .NET
general_information.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 49.5h contact hours + 145' Final exam + 98.1h self-study
general_information.Description: Upon completion of this course students shoud: 1. Understand the followings: • Apply C# language for develop ASP.NET WEB API ( RESTful Service applications ) • Fundamental concepts of .NET Core Platform • Basic knowledge of ASP.NET WEB API on .NET Core • Basic knowledge of RESTful Service and Microservice architecture 2. Be able to: • Develop Cross - platform Back-end application can be used by Desktop or Web applications (Cross - platform) • Develop RESTful Service applications by ASP.NET Web API and Windows Communication Foundation (WCF) • Implement security in the ASP.NET WEB API • Implement sending Ajax request to ASP.NET WEB API • Implement security JWT in ASP.NET Core Web API • Develop Distributed applications based on Microservice architecture 3. Be able to work in team and present group's results
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact sessions in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all assigned exercises given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to the FU CMS at http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information
general_information.Tools: - Internet - Visual Studio.NET 2019 version 16.8.3 or later - Platform : .NET 5.0 or later

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Describe about .NET Core Platform, and ASP.NET WEB API Architecture
Demonstrate Models, ODATA, Entity Framework Core ,and Media Formatters & Content Negotiation
Demonstrate about implementing security in RESTful WebService
Demonstrate about JavaScript Client and sending AJAX Requests to ASP.NET Web API
Demonstrate about implementing RESTful Services by WCF, gRPC Services and introduction about Microservices architecture.

assessments.Question Type: Multiple choices Marked by Computer or a suitable format

assessments.Note: PE > 0, TE >= 4 & Min Avg Mark To Pass >= 5
